description: This file defines the API for Zperf, a network performance testing tool, including data structures, enums, and function prototypes for UDP/TCP upload/download operations and callbacks.

methods.name: zperf_udp_upload
methods.description: Synchronous UDP upload operation, blocks until complete.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_upload
methods.description: Synchronous TCP upload operation, blocks until complete.

methods.name: zperf_udp_upload_async
methods.description: Asynchronous UDP upload operation with callback.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_upload_async
methods.description: Asynchronous TCP upload operation with callback.

methods.name: zperf_udp_download
methods.description: Start UDP server for performance testing.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_download
methods.description: Start TCP server for performance testing.
